blind.description: A stylized fantasy architectural buttress piece consisting of a vertical square stone pier and an attached curved flying buttress arch arm. The pillar has a stepped square plinth base, light grey stone molding accents, and three inset circular medallion details along its outer vertical faces. The top of the pier features a tiered cap surmounted by an upward-pointing stone crescent moon finial. The curved arch has dark stone inner masonry with a light stone cap running along its top edge, terminating in a vertical flat abutment face.
blind.from_above: A square base/cap on the left topped with a narrow almond/crescent profile, extending to the right into a straight horizontal beam with a slightly wider rectangular end cap, casting an arch-shaped shadow.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1.4 to 1.5 times the height of the figure (around 8 to 8.5 feet tall), and spanning about 4.5 to 5 feet wide horizontally.

notes: footprint proportion 2.21x off the catalog (5.6 x 1.9 ft)
